title: [main] Calculate Inventory - Add check to skip report processing if Warehouse Entry table is empty
summary: The Calculate Inventory report now skips its per-iteration Warehouse Entry processing when the Warehouse Entry table is completely empty. This avoids needless work in databases that have no warehouse entries.
key_points: Added a check for an empty Warehouse Entry table in the Calculate Inventory report
When the table is empty, Warehouse Entry processing is skipped on each iteration
Applied to both the W1 and RU Base Application layers
quote: Stop processing "Warehouse Entry" in each iteration when it is completely empty
